messages.content: How do I format a datetime as ISO 8601 in Python?

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to format a Python datetime as ISO 8601. The standard library supports this via datetime.isoformat() or strftime with the %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S format.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Use datetime.isoformat() for basic ISO format, or datetime.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") for custom precision. For timezone-aware UTC strings, use datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().</content>
</action>
